newsitem.title: BRAZIL: CVRD, shipping firm out of Brazil rail auction.
newsitem.headline: CVRD, shipping firm out of Brazil rail auction.

text.p: Brazil's Companhia Vale do Rio Doce and shipping firm Grupo Libra are not taking part in a consortium which will bid for a concession to operate the southeast section of Brazil's federal railway network, a broker said.

The MRS Logistica comprises steelmaker CSN, Cosigua, mining firms MBR and Ferteco, fertilizer company Ultrafertil, transport groups Celato and Interferrea and two pension funds, said Paulo Pinho, from Banco Primus, which will represent the group in the auction.
Vale do Rio Doce, which was previously taking part in the consortium, left the group, while Grupo Libra failed to reach an agreement with MRS members.
Investors formalized the make-up of the consortium late Tuesday, shortly before the deadline for investors to register for the auction.
Pinho ruled out the possibility of the consortium giving up the deal at the last minute. He said the group has enough resources to acquire the concession.
"They have strategic interest in the stretch. The southeast section is the most profitable of the railway network," he said.

The 1,674 km southeast stretch, which comprises mainly track in the states of Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro and Sao Paulo, will be auctioned for a minimum price of 888.9 million reais on Friday on the Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange (BVRJ).
